project.name: Python Scratch to Advanced Mastery
project.description: A structured Python roadmap from absolute fundamentals to advanced language features, DSA, backend development, automation, data processing, concurrency, internals, production engineering, projects, and interview preparation.

phases.name: Python Fundamentals
phases.description: Learn Python from scratch and build a strong programming foundation.

phases.name: Core Python Data Structures
phases.description: Master Python's built-in collection types and their practical usage.

phases.name: Functions and Modular Programming
phases.description: Learn how to write reusable, maintainable Python code.

phases.name: Object-Oriented Python
phases.description: Build strong object-oriented programming skills using Python.

phases.name: Advanced Python Language Features
phases.description: Move beyond basic Python into powerful language features.

phases.name: Error Handling, Files and Data Processing
phases.description: Learn robust error handling and file/data processing techniques.

phases.name: Python Standard Library
phases.description: Become productive with Python's most useful standard-library modules.

phases.name: Python Problem Solving and DSA
phases.description: Develop algorithmic thinking and solve DSA problems using Python.

phases.name: Python Environment, Packages and Professional Development
phases.description: Learn how professional Python projects are structured and managed.

phases.name: Testing and Debugging
phases.description: Build reliable Python applications through testing and systematic debugging.

phases.name: Concurrency, Parallelism and Async Python
phases.description: Understand threads, processes and asynchronous programming in Python.

phases.name: Python Backend Development
phases.description: Use Python to build production-style backend applications and APIs.

phases.name: Python Automation and Web Interaction
phases.description: Automate repetitive tasks and interact with websites programmatically.

phases.name: Python for Data and APIs
phases.description: Learn Python's ecosystem for data processing, analysis and API consumption.

phases.name: Advanced Python Internals
phases.description: Understand how Python works internally and write more efficient code.

phases.name: Production Python and Software Engineering
phases.description: Learn how to design, maintain, secure and deploy production-quality Python systems.

phases.name: Advanced Python Projects
phases.description: Apply advanced Python knowledge by building realistic production-style projects.

phases.name: Final Python Mastery and Interview Preparation
phases.description: Consolidate Python knowledge and prepare for technical interviews and real-world development.
